attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: AxisCADES Technologies Limited has intimated the schedule for an investors and fund managers meeting on Thursday, November 19, 2026. The interaction will be a physical group meeting held at Devanahalli Aero Land in Bengaluru. Company representatives will engage with investors and fund managers during this session. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. The details are available on the company website at www.axiscades.com. This notice is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Acquisition
voiceSummary: AxisCADES Technologies Limited informs the stock exchanges that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Ulosia Holding AG, has completed the acquisition of one hundred percent of the share capital of Titan 181. VVG GmbH. Titan 181. VVG GmbH is a company incorporated under the laws of Germany, with its seat in Hamburg, and is registered with the commercial register at the local court of Hamburg under HRB 198127. Consequently, Titan 181. VVG GmbH has become a step-down subsidiary of the Company with effect from November 17, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: AxisCADES Technologies Limited has hosted the audio recording of its Earnings Conference Call with Investors and Analysts held on November 16, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the specified URL. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: AxisCADES Technologies Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 15, 2026, in the Financial Express and Prajavani. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 and Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company references a previous letter dated November 13, 2026, concerning the outcome of the Board meeting. The announcement serves to place the financial results on record with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.
